title: astragalus parnassi var. cylleneus
intro: Astragalus parnassi var. cylleneus, commonly known as Cylene milkvetch, is a type of plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including immune system support and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus parnassi var. cylleneus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, saponins, and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
